assumptions: The raise check runs before the report is read, the instrument check and the delta rule: a raise depends only on the two baseline files, so no measurement can excuse it (mirrors #1247).
A missing or unparseable merge-base baseline abstains (exit 3); no bootstrap exemption, because main has carried .harness/perf-baseline.json since #717.
The check lives in the existing scripts/lib/perf-delta.mjs (the merge-base module) rather than a new scripts/lib file, so no entropy entryPoints or docs-coverage changes are needed.
